items.text: All round 2 decisions incorporated into plan.md. d1 (update policy JSONB → minimal schema with 3 fields), d2 (release notes → plain text passthrough), d3 (migration → existing IF NOT EXISTS DDL block), and d4 (auth → extracted requireUpdateAPIKey middleware) are now fully reflected in the Implementation Strategy, Target End State, and Contract Decisions sections.

Contract Decisions section reorganized: all 4 round-2 decisions moved from 'Pending' to 'Settled (from round 2)' with concrete details. No pending decisions remain — all contract questions are resolved.

Implementation Strategy tightened: Phase 1 now includes specific ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS DDL for both columns with exact defaults; Phase 2 specifies plain text passthrough for release notes, requireUpdateAPIKey gating on all new endpoints, and verification response shape with conditional deep fields; the greenfield constraint is stated explicitly at the top of the strategy section.

Readiness assessment: All 5 dimensions scored 3/3. Problem is fully enumerated (8 gaps). Scope has acceptance_allow and acceptance_deny defined. Approach is a concrete 4-phase plan with specific file targets and DDL. Testing plan covers 10 test areas with types specified. Risks are documented with mitigations. Plan is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Moved all round 2 decisions to settled status in Contract Decisions. Tightened Phase 1 DDL details (exact ALTER TABLE statements, JSONB default value). Tightened Phase 2 endpoint specs (plain text passthrough, conditional deep fields in verify response). Added greenfield constraint statement to Implementation Strategy header. Added requireUpdateAPIKey middleware to rollout checklist. Removed all 'pending' references.
